column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: The Party's Truth and Resolve

column2: Looks like we can't avoid fighting them as long as we're here.
We need to climb to the top of this tower and get out of here, fast!
No matter how you look at it, this reeks of a trap!
Old man, what are you planning to do with us from here on out?!
Do you all still intend to trust this old man with black $$羽$$s as your guide?
But can we really swallow everything that crazy woman said?!
But then, whose word should we believe?
In the end, all we can trust is our own judgment.
I will see the truth of this $$世界$$ with my own eyes,
and search for a way to save the oppressed!!
That is the purpose of this journey!!
If a coward like me had never met all of you...
I'd probably still be trembling in that dim prison, unable to do anything...
I'm not smart enough to understand difficult things, but...
I've always wanted to know what this thing called $$愛$$, this $$愛$$, really is!!
But isn't that, in the end... the same thing the $$教団$$ does?!
Seeking $$愛$$, seeking $$自由$$...
We may seem to defy the $$教団$$'s teachings, but what have we done for that goal?!
Fighting for what we ourselves want...
is no different from their way at all!!
For that goal... we even killed people!
And yet...
I only wanted to be of use to my $$お師匠さま$$!!
Nothing else mattered to me!
I do not truly care about truth anymore!!
Ah!!
That is not so... $$ルピルピ$$!!
For they are not being faithful to their instincts...
but to the convictions they themselves believe in...
In this $$世界$$, where saving people is a $$罪$$...
in this $$世界$$, where one's own strength is all one can rely on...
what is there to be ashamed of in pursuing one's convictions?!
Heh. When I think about it...
we've traveled this far without ever talking about any of this...
But old man, that doesn't mean I can trust you yet.
In the end, I've only been using you people too.
Can people like that really call themselves comrades?
I agree.
Even you, $$ガイさん$$? What are you saying?!
You're naive, kid!
Did you think everyone here was living by helping one another?
Of course!!
No. Why do we act together?
To survive. Haven't you been using everyone too?
$$ガイ$$ and $$レブロブス$$ are right...
Mr. $$ヨハネ$$?!
But there is one thing I wish to ask you all.
What does each of you truly want?
Whatever I may be, each of you has something you seek...
Or what?
Did you think this gathering itself was all you needed to seek?
You wish to survive!
You wish to save someone!
Or are the things you have done until now something that makes you deny yourselves?
I ask once more: what do you want?
You know... when you would not wake up, I felt terribly alone.
Because I love your eyes.
When you look at me...
it feels as though forgotten feelings might come back to me!
No matter how much you may hate me... these feelings will not change.
I was really, really scared when you would not wake up, $$お兄ちゃん$$.
I love your eyes, $$お兄ちゃん$$.
When $$お兄ちゃん$$ looks at me,
I do not understand it, but my heart gets all fluttery.
Even if $$お兄ちゃん$$ hates me, I loooove $$お兄ちゃん$$.
These feelings will not change.
I was really lonely while you would not wake up.
I only knew how to lean on someone when I could be with you.
When you look at me,
it feels as though forgotten feelings might return.
Even if everyone hates me, these feelings will never change.
I love your eyes.
When those eyes look at me, it feels like a forgotten $$記憶$$ might return.
That is why... I cannot help being dishonest!
The me you usually see... is not the real me...
Hey... you knew all along, didn't you?
You're only getting back at me because I was mean, right?!
Say you know how I feel... say you do not hate me!
When you would not wake up, I realized... how I truly felt.
I am deeply drawn to your eyes.
When you look at me, warm feelings I had forgotten seem ready to return.
Of course you hate me... but...
my feelings for you will never change.
When you would not wake up, I was damn lonely.
I... like your eyes.
When I look at you...
it feels as though forgotten feelings may come back.
No matter how much you hate me, these feelings will not change.
I want to stay together... forever...
When I saw you badly hurt...
I thought my heart would break...
I kept thinking what I would do if you died...
If you are beside me, I need nothing else.
I can do anything for you!!
Even if it is... however $$罪$$ful...
$$お兄ちゃん$$... stay with me forever...
When I found you badly hurt and collapsed, $$お兄ちゃん$$...
I thought my heart would stop from the shock!
I really, really cried until morning!
If you die, $$お兄ちゃん$$, I cannot live all alone...
If $$お兄ちゃん$$ is beside me, I do not need anything else!
I can do anything for $$お兄ちゃん$$, even if it is something very bad...
I want to stay together forever...
When I saw you badly hurt, I thought my heart would break...
If you... if you died...
I would have to go on living with my true self hidden away...
If only you would stay beside me, I would need nothing else...
I can do anything for you.
Even if I were charged with any $$大罪$$.
I wish we could stay together... forever and ever...
I think I could only lean on someone when I was with you.
When you look at me...
it feels like forgotten feelings might come back...
Even if everyone despises me, these feelings...
will never, ever change.
You will stay with me... forever...

I wondered what I would do if you died...
If you stay beside me... I need nothing else.
You hate me, don't you...?
But I...
Let's stay together forever.
When I saw you badly hurt, I thought my heart would break.
If you died...
I wondered what I would do...
If you stay beside me, I need nothing else.
I can do anything for you!
Even if I am charged with any $$罪$$.
Heh, you're right!
None of us can do this alone.
If we split up, we cannot do what we want anyway.
Tch. So that is how it ends up, huh?
Figures this old man spent so long as a $$大神官$$.
We'd better watch out, or he'll talk circles around us!
Old man, now I have a question for you.
The truth is up there, right?!
Yes!!
Then it's settled!!
Staying here gets us nowhere! We will throw our feelings at this $$世界$$ itself!!
I told $$ガイ$$ before that the truth lies above us...
But perhaps that was not quite right.
Perhaps the truth is already... in each of your hearts.
Come, let us go!
We have not yet seen where this $$世界$$ is headed!
